jobs.title: Junior Software Developer - System Integration Labs (North Shore)
jobs.description:
Our engineers are the technical visionaries behind our innovative solutions. Globally recognized for delivering cutting\-edge systems, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate across functions, and lead advancements that shape our industry. Supported by a culture of flexibility, growth, and innovation, join us to create a lasting legacy in safety and simulation.  

**Description**

As a Software Developer, you will develop real\-time simulation software used in military aircraft system integration laboratories. These engineering simulators reproduce aircraft systems and functions so that teams can test and validate software before it is installed on an aircraft. The emphasis is on aircraft controls and system behaviour rather than visual simulation.  



  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop object\-oriented software components, primarily in C\+\+, to reproduce aircraft behaviour in real time.
* Simulate the digital and analog signals associated with the aircraft’s avionics systems.
* Participate in all phases of software development, including problem analysis, requirements definition, design, implementation, informal testing, troubleshooting, and integration.
* Support the software’s user community.
* Work with several simulation models used for a single aircraft and adapt your approach to different systems and technical requirements.
* Collaborate within a multidisciplinary team of approximately 10 employees, including a subgroup of approximately four employees that works closely with other subgroups.
* Work autonomously while collaborating regularly with software, systems, avionics, and other engineering groups.

Valid driver’s license, or ability to commute to the Mirabel offices  

* 

  

**This is a full\-time, Monday\-Friday hybrid working arrangement, with an expected presence of two to three days per week at the Mirabel office and occasional work from the Saint\-Laurent office. Employees are expected to work 40 hours per week, and core working hours are from 9:30AM – 3:30PM.**

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science.
* Up to three years of software development experience.
* Knowledge of C\+\+ and C\#.
* Ability to learn aircraft systems, simulation models, and new technical concepts quickly.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage changing technical requirements, and demonstrate flexibility across multiple simulation models.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Ability to communicate orally and in writing about technical subjects in English or French.
* Ability to meet the requirements of Canada’s Controlled Goods Program and, in certain cases, applicable International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements.

Eligibility to obtain and maintain Government of Canada Reliability Status and a Level II Secret security clearance.  

* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Rust or Java.
* Knowledge of FPGA development or technologies.
* Knowledge of aeronautics, avionics, or aircraft systems.
* Experience developing real\-time simulation software.

Demonstrated interest in aviation.  

* 

  

**Benefits**

We’ve designed flexible policies to promote well\-being and growth, based on role\-specific eligibility and requirements:


* Hybrid work arrangement combining office\-based and remote work.
* Flexible working hours.
* Career development and internal mobility opportunities within CAE.
* Mentoring and access to the CAE Career Track program.
* Collaborative and positive work environment.
* Opportunity to be part of a small professional community within a large organization.
* Work\-life balance.
* Comprehensive CAE benefits program, including health insurance, an employee stock purchase plan, a pension plan, and a physical activity program.

**About CAE**
=============

*At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose\-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.*

Bienvenue là où l’humain est au cœur de tout.


Bienvenue aux gens qui ont une vision d’avenir inspirante et qui sont à la recherche de défis stimulants. Chez nous, vous aurez d’innombrables occasions d’apprendre et de développer des compétences variées en travaillant sur des projets mobilisateurs.

Relevant de la Gestionnaire principale ERP, la ou le spécialiste en soutien applicatif ERP et amélioration continue agit comme point central de soutien opérationnel pour l’environnement Dynamics 365 et les applications connexes. Son rôle consiste à assurer une prise en charge rapide, rigoureuse et documentée des demandes, à améliorer la qualité du support aux utilisateurs et à contribuer à la continuité des opérations ERP.


La ou le titulaire du poste facilite la collaboration entre les utilisateurs, les analystes fonctionnels, les équipes techniques et les partenaires externes, tout en contribuant à l’amélioration continue des processus, des pratiques de soutien et de la documentation opérationnelle.


Ce poste vise à réduire la charge opérationnelle des analystes fonctionnels afin qu’ils puissent consacrer davantage de temps aux activités à valeur ajoutée, telles que l’analyse fonctionnelle, la gouvernance, l’amélioration des processus et la qualité des solutions.

**Principales responsabilités**

**Support aux utilisateurs et gestion des demandes**

* Assurer le support fonctionnel de premier et deuxième niveaux pour les utilisateurs ERP
* Recevoir, qualifier, documenter et faire le suivi des incidents et des demandes de service
* Effectuer le triage initial des demandes et les acheminer vers les équipes appropriées lorsque requis
* Maintenir un haut niveau de satisfaction utilisateur par un suivi rigoureux, clair et proactif

**Analyse initiale et collaboration fonctionnelle**

* Effectuer une première qualification des problématiques afin de clarifier les impacts, l’urgence et les actions requises
* Identifier les tendances et les causes récurrentes des incidents afin de soutenir la priorisation des améliorations
* Collaborer avec les analystes fonctionnels dans l’analyse des incidents plus complexes, sans se substituer à leur rôle d’analyse détaillée
* Recommander des améliorations visant à réduire les demandes répétitives, les irritants utilisateurs et les interruptions opérationnelles

**Documentation, connaissances et amélioration continue**

* Maintenir une documentation claire et structurée favorisant le partage des connaissances, notamment les FAQ, guides utilisateurs, procédures et documents opérationnels
* Contribuer à la standardisation des pratiques de soutien et à l’amélioration continue du service
* Alimenter et maintenir les bases de connaissances utilisées par les agents IA et les outils de support

**Vigie opérationnelle et administration ERP**

* Effectuer la surveillance quotidienne des opérations ERP, notamment les transactions bloquées, les flux de travail en attente et les anomalies opérationnelles
* Gérer les demandes d’accès, de sécurité, de rôles et de licences selon les procédures établies
* Effectuer les opérations liées aux arrivées, départs et mouvements internes des employés dans l’ERP
* Administrer et maintenir les vues utilisateurs et configurer les éléments simples selon les procédures établies
* Participer à la documentation des configurations opérationnelles

  

**Qualifications**  

* Diplôme universitaire ou collégial en informatique, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe
* Expérience en soutien applicatif ERP, support aux utilisateurs ou systèmes d’affaires
* Connaissance de Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations, d’un ERP ou d’une plateforme d’affaires similaire
* Bonne compréhension des pratiques de support utilisateur, de Service Desk, de gestion des incidents et de suivi des demandes
* Aptitude à documenter clairement les procédures, les solutions et les connaissances opérationnelles
* Expérience avec Azure DevOps ou un outil comparable pour le suivi des demandes, considérée comme un atout
* Connaissance des processus de gestion de projet, de comptabilité de projet ou d’approvisionnement, considérée comme un atout
* Bilinguisme : maîtrise du français et niveau d’anglais intermédiaire à avancé, à l’oral et à l’écrit
* Excellent sens du service à la clientèle et capacité à communiquer clairement avec des utilisateurs non techniques
* Grande rigueur, souci du détail, autonomie et capacité à prioriser plusieurs demandes simultanément
* Esprit d’amélioration continue et intérêt pour l’automatisation, les outils IA et l’optimisation du support

POSITION SUMMARY

PK is currently looking for a creative, self\-starting, Junior Software Engineer who is ready to develop new products with passion and precision.

You will design and implement new features in PK’s software projects: Loudspeaker remote control application (.dynamics), mobile applications, and internal PK software tools to aid in development and manufacturing. You will also participate in shaping the future of the software department at PK Sound, helping make long\-term technology choices to improve and scale the software. Working with customers across the globe on some of the highest\-profile events and venues, what you create will have a significant impact not only for the company but the millions of people who enjoy experiencing our loudspeakers.

ABOUT PK SOUND

PK Sound is an owner\-operated, advanced loudspeaker manufacturer, proudly headquartered in Calgary, Alberta Canada, servicing the world. We pride ourselves on being a fresh alternative to the status quo, providing creative and innovative solutions in an ever\-evolving marketplace. It is one thing to hear music, it is another to experience it. PK Sound was born out of the marriage of acoustic engineering and human emotion, in facilitation of the connection between artist and fan. We measure performance as much in the reaction of a devoted fan as in the read\-out of a lab instrument. In all we do, wherever the PK logo appears, there can be no compromise, and no end in our desire to achieve new standards of performance, better ways of collaboration, and new avenues of innovation to advance industry technology for all.

There is no doubt we work hard, but we share in the success, and we have a lot of fun doing it. If you are looking for a company with an amazing brand, industry\-changing technology, an exceptional workplace environment, and that is poised to aggressively grow on the global market, this job is for you!

* Employee ownership equity program

* Fun work environment
* Attractive benefits

* Ensure reliable operation of products under extreme conditions.
* Communicate progress and problems to management and other departments.
* Create product documentation and user manuals.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with business users, project managers, and other engineers.

**Who we are:**


Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI\-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest\-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

**Our culture:**

* We hire talented, self\-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
* We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get\-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.
* We're a remote\-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to \- work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport\-optional, work\-from\-anywhere\-on\-Earth kind of remote \- think flexible *within* your country, not borderless.

**Location:**

* Remote \- United States or Canada

**About the role**


We are looking for a Senior Data/ML Engineer to own the data and machine learning foundation that Sardine's compliance decisions run on. Every onboarding decision we make — a payment approved, an account blocked, a KYC case escalated — is the output of a pipeline someone built. This role owns those pipelines end to end: how data arrives, how it becomes a feature, how that feature becomes a model, and how that model stays correct in production.


This is a high\-impact, highly technical IC role sitting at the intersection of data engineering and ML engineering. We need someone at the senior level to set technical direction for the next order of magnitude: new feature generation, build specific models around KYC onboarding, in house entity matcher for the sanctions and more


You will write production code, make architectural calls that outlive your tenure, and raise the bar for how a small team ships fraud ML. You will work directly with data scientists, backend engineers, and the fraud analysts who use what you build.

**What you'll be doing**

* Own the data ingestion layer that brings device telemetry, transaction events, KYC/identity signals, and third\-party enrichment into the platform — designing streaming pipelines (Pub/Sub, Apache Beam on Dataflow, Flink) and batch pipelines (Python, Airflow on Cloud Composer, Spark on Dataproc) that are correct, observable, and cheap to extend.
* Build and evolve our feature platform, where the same Chronon feature definitions are computed by Flink for streaming and Spark for batch, with aggregation windows from one hour to 300 days, served to the rules engine and to models under a sub\-second budget.
* Establish feature correctness as an engineering discipline: streaming\-versus\-batch reconciliation, recomputation tests against the warehouse, train/serve parity checks, and drift monitoring that catches a broken feature before an analyst does.
* Productionize fraud and identity ML models — training pipelines on Vertex AI and Kubeflow, gradient\-boosted and tree\-based models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, scikit\-learn), hyperparameter search, SHAP\-based explanations, and score normalization — and build the automated retraining, champion/challenger promotion, and rollback machinery we don't yet have.
* Engineer KYC, AML, and identity risk signals: document verification and doc\-KYC outcomes, sanctions/PEP/adverse\-media screening results, email and phone risk, synthetic identity indicators, bank and account verification, and periodic customer due diligence — turning noisy, multi\-vendor, multi\-jurisdiction data into features a model can actually learn from.
* Integrate and harden new data sources, including 30\+ third\-party enrichment providers called in parallel on the request path, plus our cross\-client consortium network — owning failover behavior, timeout budgets, graceful degradation, caching, and cost.
* Own the warehouse and modeling layer in BigQuery — partitioning strategy, the staging\-to\-mart layer cake, training datasets, and the in\-flight migration off dbt onto scheduled SQL and Python pipelines.
* Design the entity resolution and graph data that link customers, devices, emails, phones, cards, bank accounts, and crypto addresses across clients, including large\-scale connected\-components work.
* Make the platform safe by construction: field\-level encryption for sensitive identifiers, regional data residency enforced in the pipeline definitions, PII handling and deletion paths, and feature\-level gating so a bad signal can be turned off without a deploy.
* Set technical direction and raise the team's ceiling — write the design docs, run the reviews, mentor engineers and data scientists, and decide what we build versus buy.

**What you'll need**

* 8\+ years building production data and ML systems, with real ownership of both the pipeline side and the model side. You have shipped models that made consequential automated decisions, not just dashboards.
* Deep Python and strong SQL. You are fluent in a distributed processing framework (Spark, Beam, or Flink) and comfortable reasoning about streaming semantics — windowing, watermarks, late data, exactly\-once versus at\-least\-once, and where correctness actually breaks.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data stack: GCP strongly preferred (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Bigtable, Composer, Vertex AI) or the AWS equivalents, plus Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/C

Bienvenue là où l’humain est au cœur de tout.

Relevant de la Gestionnaire principale ERP, la ou le spécialiste en soutien applicatif ERP et amélioration continue agit comme point central de soutien opérationnel pour l’environnement Dynamics 365 et les applications connexes. La ou le titulaire du poste facilite la collaboration entre les utilisateurs, les analystes fonctionnels, les équipes techniques et les partenaires externes, tout en contribuant à l’amélioration continue des processus, des pratiques de soutien et de la documentation opérationnelle.

* Alimenter et maintenir les bases de connaissances utilisées par les agents IA et les outils de support

* Gérer les demandes d’accès, de sécurité, de rôles et de licences selon les procédures établies

* Participer à la documentation des configurations opérationnelles

  

**Qualifications**  

* Diplôme universitaire ou collégial en informatique, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe
* Expérience en soutien applicatif ERP, support aux utilisateurs ou systèmes d’affaires
* Connaissance de Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations, d’un ERP ou d’une plateforme d’affaires similaire
* Bonne compréhension des pratiques de support utilisateur, de Service Desk, de gestion des incidents et de suivi des demandes
* Aptitude à documenter clairement les procédures, les solutions et les connaissances opérationnelles
* Expérience avec Azure DevOps ou un outil comparable pour le suivi des demandes, considérée comme un atout
* Connaissance des processus de gestion de projet, de comptabilité de projet ou d’approvisionnement, considérée comme un atout
* Bilinguisme : maîtrise du français et niveau d’anglais intermédiaire à avancé, à l’oral et à l’écrit
* Excellent sens du service à la clientèle et capacité à communiquer clairement avec des utilisateurs non techniques
* Grande rigueur, souci du détail, autonomie et capacité à prioriser plusieurs demandes simultanément
* Esprit d’amélioration continue et intérêt pour l’automatisation, les outils IA et l’optimisation du support

**About Peloton Technologies**
------------------------------

At Peloton Technologies, we’re transforming the payments landscape for small businesses and enterprises alike. Our platform helps business owners manage payments, optimize cash flow, and streamline operations — from seamless point\-of\-sale transactions to enterprise payment solutions. Founded in 2010 on Vancouver Island, Peloton has grown into a national brand with a team working remotely across Canada. Our culture is grounded in five core values — Teamwork, Respect, Trust, Innovation, and Passion — that shape how we collaborate and make decisions.

Collaborating with the team, you’ll help determine solutions for end users’ needs and work with end user requirements to design and develop code that delivers effective solutions.
